Owner occupied option is a wonderful start for the first-time homebuyer as you live mortgage free! Located near major highways, shopping, dining, strolling distance to educational buildings, indoor and outdoor activities for all ages! Norwalk is excited to welcome you & your tenant's home! **Currently fully rented with well established tenants for your convenience
